answer.rationale: Renewal currently best satisfies the requirement not to increase delivery risk: the line has no buffer, expiry is in 14 days, and memory_c1 indicates incumbent continuity. Memory_c2 supports switching on cost and onboarding, but does not establish delivery reliability at committed volume. Verify both records before committing; renewal may miss the finance target, but an immediate primary switch could create greater total-cost exposure through disruption.
